en.title: Minimum Adjustments to Make Two Shipments Equal
en.description:
Cut once between adjacent categories to form two non-empty contiguous shipments; one operation adds one to or subtracts one from the quantity of any category, but every quantity must stay positive. Find the minimum number of operations to make the two shipments' totals equal.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n values of quantity. Full ranges from the original OCR: 2≤n≤300000, 1≤quantity[i]≤2000000000.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 1; 0; 2. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Scan every non-empty split point and take the minimum absolute difference between the left and right totals.
